Statistics of [[Süper Lig|Turkish First Football League]] in season 1987–88.

==Overview==
Twenty clubs participated, and [[Galatasaray S.K. (football team)|Galatasaray S.K.]] won the championship. [[Denizlispor]], [[Kocaelispor]], [[Gençlerbirliği]] and [[Zonguldakspor]] were relegated to [[TFF First League|Second League]].

This was  the first season where clubs were awarded 3 points for victories, in contrast to previous years where a victory had earned the winning club only 2 points.
